actual_scope: For the Q8 regular left action on eight equal-width binary address blocks, prove a uniform displacement-rank floor and conditional bit-cell instruction-count lower bound for every rank-one binary idempotent coupling. Audit the selected source roots for a named caller. No native supplier mapping or new kappa.
scope_change_reason: The remaining Q8 handoff asks for an actual recursive caller. The selected-source inventory does not name one. To make a useful bounded contribution without assuming a caller, this refines the Q8 nonabelian model to a precise rank-one bit-cell instruction alphabet and proves its all-parameter lower bound; caller admission remains a separate open obligation.
bottleneck_link: A Q8 address operation cannot be assigned a unit bit-cell price without a displacement-rank argument. This floor constrains one explicit implementation alphabet and makes clear what data is still needed before converting it to a selected supplier cost.
stop_rule: Stop after the written all-r,B proof, independent exact finite replay and controls, exact source pins, and bounded selected-caller inventory. Do not infer a supplier saving or expand the Q8 family without a named caller and complete physical invoice.
